capabilities: index Markdown notes locally without an external database
retrieve relevant note passages as chat context
chat with any OpenAI-compatible API, including OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, and LM Studio
attach Markdown files or send selected text to a chat
rebuild, update, and clear the memory index and save chat sessions
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns not to configure a provider you do not trust with your note content, since prompts include note excerpts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an AI questions grounded in your own notes; users must manually copy context into external chat tools.

relations.evidence: Support for any OpenAI-compatible API, including OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio, and self-hosted services.
relations.plugin: OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio)

summary: Local AI chat that indexes Markdown notes, retrieves relevant passages, and sends them as context to any OpenAI-compatible API provider.
